parameters.query:
=-- One row per user to recommend for, with all signals + the candidate pool as JSON.
-- {{ $json.user_id ?? 'NULL' }} is either a validated integer (single-user run) or NULL (daily batch).
with target as (select {{ $json.user_id ?? 'NULL' }}::int as user_id)
select
  u.id                                 as user_id,
  '{{ $json.source }}'                 as source,
  coalesce(a.title, 'recovery')        as addiction_label,
  coalesce(ci.checkins,   '[]'::json)  as recent_checkins,
  coalesce(wl.low_areas,  '[]'::json)  as lowest_wheel_areas,
  coalesce(cl.lessons,    '[]'::json)  as recent_lessons,
  cand.candidates                      as candidates
from public.users u
cross join target t
left join public.addictions a on a.enum_id = u.addiction
-- last 5 daily check-ins from the app-owned table (mood 0-100, emotion tags, use behaviour)
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object(
           'date', mc.date, 'mood', mc.mood,
           'struggling_with', mc.negative, 'feeling_good_about', mc.positive,
           'used', mc.behavior, 'amount_vs_usual', mc.amount)
         order by mc.date desc) as checkins
  from (select * from public.mobile_checkins
        where app_user_id = u.id
        order by date desc limit 5) mc
) ci on true
-- 3 lowest current Wheel of Life areas (latest score per area, 0-10 scale)
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object('area', r.title, 'score', r.score) order by r.score) as low_areas
  from (
    select la.title, x.score
    from (
      select distinct on (ws.life_area_id) ws.life_area_id, ws.score
      from public.wheel_of_life_scores ws
      where ws.user_id = u.id
      order by ws.life_area_id, ws.created_at desc
    ) x
    join public.life_areas la on la.id = x.life_area_id
    order by x.score asc
    limit 3
  ) r
) wl on true
-- 5 most recently touched lessons (topic signal)
left join lateral (
  select json_agg(l.title order by c.at desc) as lessons
  from (
    select cl.lesson_id, max(cl.updated_at) as at
    from public.completed_lessons cl
    where cl.user_id = u.id
    group by cl.lesson_id
    order by 2 desc nulls last
    limit 5
  ) c
  join public.lessons l on l.id = c.lesson_id
) cl on true
-- candidate pool: classified snippets with a playable video, not already
-- recommended to this user in the last 60 days. Newest 40.
join lateral (
  select json_agg(json_build_object(
           'snippet_id', c.id, 'title', c.title,
           'summary', c.summary, 'seconds', c.length_seconds)) as candidates
  from (
    select s.id,
           coalesce(nullif(trim(s.title), ''),
                    nullif(nullif(trim(s.description), ''), 'No description available'),
                    left(s.ai_summary, 80),
                    'Untitled video')            as title,
           left(coalesce(s.ai_summary, ''), 280) as summary,
           s.length_seconds
    from public.snippets s
    where s.classified = true
      and (s.vimeo_id is not null or s.vimeo_url is not null)
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.user_snippets us
        where us.user_id = u.id and us.snippet_id = s.id
          and us.created_at > now() - interval '60 days')
    order by s.created_at desc
    limit 40
  ) c
) cand on true
where cand.candidates is not null
  and ( (t.user_id is not null and u.id = t.user_id)
     or (t.user_id is null and exists (
           select 1 from public.mobile_checkins mc
           where mc.app_user_id = u.id
             and mc.date >= (now() - interval '14 days')::date)) )
limit 500;

=-- Insert the picks. INSERT-ONLY into the production table; the NOT EXISTS makes
-- re-runs idempotent (no duplicate rec for the same user+snippet within 60 days).
-- user_id and id_list are validated integers from the Code node.
insert into public.user_snippets (user_id, snippet_id, created_at, updated_at)
select {{ $json.user_id }}, sid, now(), now()
from unnest(array[{{ $json.id_list }}]::bigint[]) as sid
where not exists (
  select 1 from public.user_snippets us
  where us.user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}
    and us.snippet_id = sid
    and us.created_at > now() - interval '60 days'
)
returning snippet_id;

=-- OPTIONAL observability: why each pick was made. Requires log-table.sql to have
-- been run once; this node is set to continue on error so the flow still works
-- without the table.
insert into public.mobile_recommendation_log (user_id, snippet_id, reason, model, run_source)
select {{ $json.user_id }}, (p->>'snippet_id')::bigint, p->>'reason', 'claude-opus-4-8', '{{ $json.source }}'
from json_array_elements('{{ $json.picks_sql }}'::json) p;

meta._comment: SPARx recommendation engine v2. After import: (1) open the three Postgres nodes and the Anthropic node and pick your saved credentials (marked REPLACE); (2) Save + toggle Active; (3) optionally run log-table.sql once and point a Supabase Database Webhook (INSERT on public.mobile_checkins) at the production webhook URL for instant post-check-in recommendations. Node typeVersions may differ in your n8n — if a node warns after import, delete it and re-add the same node from the palette, copying the parameters shown here. Do NOT set temperature on the Anthropic node: current Claude models (Opus 4.7+/Sonnet 5) reject sampling parameters.
